correctness.rationale: For every affine ell-flat choose ell independent coordinate restrictions, giving an injective projection of its integer points into the stars-and-bars lattice simplex with exactly binomial(k+ell,ell) points. Equality forces integer lifts of 0 and k e_i, fixes the affine graph z(y)=a(1-sum(y)/k), and integrality at e_i forces k|a_j. Nonnegative total sum<=k leaves only a=0 or a=k e_j (directly also for k=1), hence the ell-face hulls and their count binomial(d+1,ell+1). No unstated smoothness/genericity or finite-to-infinite inference is used. The standalone exact checker verifies 18 small cases, 2499 affine flats; it is corroboration, not proof.

The source theorem establishing eventual quasi-polynomiality for lattice diameter lines is compatible with this constant count.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: An identically positive constant cannot agree eventually with a genuine quasi-polynomial of positive exact degree d-ell, so the stated exact-degree universal conjecture is falsified. value.rationale: A natural and precise infinite-family extremal problem is fully solved for every dimension, slice dimension and integer dilation, with an iff description of every maximizer. This provides a decisive universal counterfamily to an explicit recent exact-degree conjecture, clarifies the needed formulation of any repaired conjecture, and distinguishes true maximizer rigidity from ordinary Ehrhart count growth. It is more than a routine isolated example or finite numerical gain.
